description: Search and read in one call: runs a web search (or news search) and returns the top 1 to 5 result pages as clean Markdown together with title, URL and snippet, so the agent gets content instead of links. Pages that cannot be read are reported per result. Charged only if at least one page was read. Params: query (required), source ('web' default or 'news'), count (1 to 5, default 3), max_chars per page (500 to 20000, default 4000). Price: $0.012 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"query":"x402 payment protocol","count":2,"max_chars":3000}.
name: search_read
title: Search and Read
